messages:
marco_finance: Heads-up - vendor "Brava Tech SA" (Brazil) emailed an invoice and asked us to gross-up for Brazilian withholding. Anyone on BR tax?

ana_brazil_tax: looping @taxbot. Quick context: Brazil can have multiple levies on service payments (IRRF, ISS, social contributions). Need to know vendor CNPJ and whether they issued a NF-e (nota fiscal) or RPS. Also whether the services qualify as exported services (which may be exempt). Gross-up requests are commercial; tax typically withholds at source unless exempt.

lucy_procurement: Invoice snippet pasted: ```
Invoice: BRV-2026-410
Vendor: Brava Tech S.A.
CNPJ: 12.345.678/0001-90
Amount: USD 18,750
Description: Cloud integration & config hours
Vendor note: "Please gross-up to cover local withholding so net received is USD 18,750."
```

caio_vendor_relations: I spoke with their accounting team. They said they can't get payroll done unless we gross-up. Offered to provide a nota fiscal if needed. Asked if a 7-day payment instead of gross-up would work.

taxbot: Internal: confirm CNPJ on Receita Federal, request NF-e/RPS, and ascertain service place of supply. See internal Brazil tax playbook. Withholding rates and rules depend on service nature and municipality (ISS) plus federal IRRF rules.

ana_brazil_tax: Action items: 1) AP request copy of NF-e or RPS + CNPJ verification screenshot. 2) Vendor to confirm whether services were performed in Brazil or exported. 3) Finance will not gross-up by default; we withhold per statutory rules unless contract says otherwise or counsel advises.

marco_finance: Sent official doc request at 13:02 asking for NF-e/RPS, CNPJ proof, and confirmation of where the work was performed. Also offered Net15 as an alternate to gross-up.

caio_vendor_relations: Vendor replied quickly: they attached a scanned nota fiscal and say services rendered from Brazil. They reiterated gross-up ask and offered a 5% discount if we process net.

lucy_procurement: Commercial note: procurement prefers to avoid gross-up. If vendor accepts a discount or faster payment, might close faster. But we need tax clearance first.

ana_brazil_tax: With NF-e + Brazil residency confirmed, likely withholding applies. I'm opening a quick consult with local counsel to confirm exact IRRF/ISS treatment and the combined withholding rate. For now: place an AP hold and do not gross-up. Provide vendor guidance that they can claim credit locally and we will issue the withholding certificate.

marco_finance: AP placed hold at 13:21. Not releasing payment until counsel memo or contract amendment. I'll share counsel note when available. :white_check_mark:

caio_vendor_relations: I'll tell vendor we can't gross-up and that AP is holding payment pending tax check; also offer Net10 if they accept the invoice net. They prefer net + faster payment but said they'll wait for counsel note if needed.

taxbot: Reminder: retain NF-e, CNPJ validation screenshot, correspondence, and withholding certificate for audit. If counsel says to withhold, we'll compute withholding on BRL-equivalent per invoice date and issue certificate.
